#!/bin/bash
# Paper Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
PROJECT=paper
API_URL=https://fill.papermc.io/v3
USER_AGENT="MSH-Pterodactyl-Egg/1.0 (https://github.com/gekware/minecraft-server-hibernation-pterodactyl-egg)"

apt update
apt install -y curl jq

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
	echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')`
else
    PROJECT_DATA=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" "${API_URL}/projects/${PROJECT}") || exit 1
    if printf '%s' "${PROJECT_DATA}" | jq -e --arg VERSION "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" '.versions | any(.[]; index($VERSION) != null)' > /dev/null; then
        echo "Version is valid. Using version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    else
        MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(printf '%s' "${PROJECT_DATA}" | jq -er '.versions | to_entries[0].value[0] | select(type == "string" and length > 0)') || exit 1
        echo "Using the latest ${PROJECT} version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    fi

    VERSION_DATA=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" "${API_URL}/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}") || exit 1
    if printf '%s' "${VERSION_DATA}" | jq -e --arg BUILD "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '.builds | any(.[]; tostring == $BUILD)' > /dev/null; then
        echo "Build is valid for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}. Using build ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
    else
        BUILD_NUMBER=$(printf '%s' "${VERSION_DATA}" | jq -er '.builds[0] | select(type == "number")') || exit 1
        echo "Using the latest ${PROJECT} build for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
    fi

    BUILD_DATA=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" "${API_URL}/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}") || exit 1
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(printf '%s' "${BUILD_DATA}" | jq -er '.downloads."server:default".url | select(type == "string" and startswith("https://"))') || exit 1
    echo "Downloading ${PROJECT} ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} build ${BUILD_NUMBER} as ${SERVER_JARFILE}"
fi


cd /mnt/server || exit 1

arch=$(uname -m)

if [ ! -f ./msh_server.bin ]; then
  if [[ $arch == x86_64* ]]; then
    echo "MSH: X64 Architecture"
    echo -e "Running curl -o msh_server.bin ${MSH_D_URL}msh-linux-amd64.bin"
    curl -o msh_server.bin ${MSH_D_URL}msh-linux-amd64.bin
  elif  [[ $arch == aarch64* ]]; then
    echo "MSH: aarch64 Architecture"
    echo -e "Running curl -o msh_server.bin ${MSH_D_URL}msh-linux-arm64.bin"
    curl -o msh_server.bin ${MSH_D_URL}msh-linux-arm64.bin
  elif  [[ $arch == arm* ]]; then
    echo "MSH: ARM not V8 is not supported..."
  elif  [[ $arch == unknown* ]]; then
    echo "MSH: Architecture dedection failed..."
    return 1
  fi
else
    echo "MSH BINARY FOUND, NOT RE DOWNLOADING"
fi

echo -e "Running curl -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

# Download successfully before replacing an existing server jar.
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}.tmp" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" || exit 1
if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old" || exit 1
fi
mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}.tmp" "${SERVER_JARFILE}" || exit 1

chmod u+x ./msh_server.bin

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo -e "Downloading MC server.properties"
    curl -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties
fi

if [ ! -f msh-config.json ]; then
    echo -e "Downloading MSH msh-config.json"
    curl -o msh-config.json https://gist.githubusercontent.com/BolverBlitz/fa895e8062fcab7dd7a54d768843a261/raw/7224a0694a985ba1bff0b4fe9b44f2c79e9b495e/msh-config.json
fi
